description: Use as BUYER or SELLER to check a quote and its onchain deal: status (pending, confirmed, funded, released), dealId, counter, who has funded. Poll this or use webhooks. Only the two parties can read it. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_quote_status
